newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ZOLA FIT FOR CHELSEA IN F.A. CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZOLA FIT FOR CHELSEA IN F.A. CUP FINAL.

text.p: Chelsea's Italian international striker Gianfranco Zola has recovered from a hamstring injury and will be fit for the F.A. Cup final against Middlesbrough on May 17.
But the diminutive 29-year-old, voted the English League's Footballer of the Year last week, is being rested for Chelsea's last league match against Everton on Sunday.
"I've only been fit for training for two days and with muscle injuries you have to be careful," Zola said following a training session at the club's training ground on Friday.
Manager Ruud Gullit said his other Italian striker Gianluca Vialli would play up front against Everton.
Chelsea are still in the running for a UEFA Cup place, but they hope to be playing in the Cup Winners' Cup instead.
Gullit said he had a squad of 21 fit first team players to choose from against Everton and for the Cup final.
"But I won't be naming the team until the day," he said.
